_about: Single source of truth for the Radha's Homemade Q&A assistant. The assistant may only say what is in this file. Update this file when the menu, ordering or events change.

business.name: Radha's Homemade (Radha's Kitchen)
business.tagline: 15-minute dinners from family recipes and real spices. Homemade, small batch, no preservatives.

ordering.how: Pay on Cash App, then call or text Radha with your order and a pickup time.
ordering.prices: Prices change with the weekly menu. Call or text 832-477-1643 for this week's menu and prices.
ordering.pickup: Pickup is in Katy. The pickup time is arranged when you call or text your order.
ordering.delivery: Local delivery is available around Katy. Call or text to check your address and arrange a time.
ordering.hours: There are no fixed shop hours. Call or text to arrange a pickup time.

events.name: Old Katy Farmers Market
events.details: Samples of Butter Masala, Spinach Masala and Chickpea Masala.

categories.name: 15-Minute Dinners
categories.what: Fully cooked curry sauces in 16 oz pouches. Vegetarian sauces: just add your protein or veggies.
categories.how_to_use: Brown your protein or veggies, pour in the sauce with a splash of water, and simmer for about 10 minutes.

items.name: Butter Masala
items.notes: For butter chicken: brown the chicken, add the sauce with a cup of water and a cup of cream, and simmer for 10 minutes. Also works as a pizza base, pasta sauce, for wings or in sandwiches.

categories.name: Lentil Curries
categories.what: Ready to eat. Thaw and serve, or add water for a hearty lentil soup.

items.name: Kidney Beans Masala
items.notes: Fully cooked: warm it in a pot for a few minutes and pour it over rice.

categories.name: Rice Mixes
categories.what: Savory Indian rice mix. Add water and cook for about 12 minutes.

categories.name: Snacks & Drinks
categories.what: Crispy, savory and ready to eat.

allergens_from_names: Ingredient names only: Tomato Peanut Chutney has peanuts, Cilantro Coconut Chutney and Turmeric Coconut Rice have coconut, and Protein Bites have nuts. For any allergy, please check with Radha before ordering.
handoff: Radha can help with that directly. Call or text 832-477-1643.
